title: 194章 空留故人任风乱193章 失落的时代悲歌
lines: 将他们送到这里的陆望舒便是很快的离去。“这里便是人间了吗？”子矜兴奋的直喊，但是随后像是想起了什么一般，有些惆怅地说道：“张荼，你说这个世间，真的存在宿命么？”
“为什么这么说？”张荼打量着这片天地，像是人间，但是又不完全像是，一时间他也很难分辨，但是陆望舒应该不会蒙骗他们才对。
“没什么。”子矜的声音有些低沉，因为在她的心中，自从来到这里之后，始终有着一种感觉，自己似乎最终还是会回到这里。
下一秒，张荼发现自己的综合性通讯器瞬间满格信号之后，这才确定他们确实已经回到了人间，看了一眼时间的自动校对，他们消失的时间竟是仅仅过去了一日一夜。
三人都拿出了手机再次确认和更新，以及去各个平台默默地窥视，这时候终于相信，那在山脉上的漫长岁月可是在人间竟是仅仅过去了一日夜。张荼默默地回首望去，只见一片一望无际的开阔平原，哪里有半丝山脉的踪影。
要变强，一定要变强！
在看到了轮回海的诡异，以及角木蛟还有黑衣剑客的悲惨境遇，看到了乞儿剑尊的选择，以及陆望舒的坚守，让他心中难以平静，他有一种严重的危机感，同时内心深处有着一种明悟，或许，他的对手，从来都不在这人间之中。
他们进入轮回海的过程，或许是有人有意而为之，但是张荼的内心深处，其实并不反感，对于被认同和赋予重任，他的内心是开心的，为了这个人间，为了自己的种族，总要是有人要站出来。他唯一忧虑的是，他顶不顶得住。
三人并没有留驻在原地，而是快速地前进，想要找到就近的香火古城，确定一下具体的信息。如今的世界之中多了其他的缤纷色彩，整个世界都笼罩在朦胧的清辉之中，温暖芳香的气息扑面而来，这让三人多少有些恍若隔世。
走出眼前的一片荒凉，张荼等人一路前行，来到了一片绿洲之中，茂密的丛林让他们想起了圣山之上的那一片诡异的绿洲。但是眼前从远古走出的丛林却是有着勃勃的生机，让张荼等人感觉到一阵心旷神怡。
不过美中不足的是，当三个人升空而起之时。却是发现了眼前这一片鲜花烂漫，芳草鲜嫩，绿树摇波的净土，在霞光点点之中有着几处宛如疤痕一般的区域，破坏了原本的和谐与宁静。
显然战火已经燃烧了这个世外桃源。
若是没有妖祸，眼前的这座森林之城，从外表看去，就像是一座没有尘世的喧嚣，没有世间的勾心斗角，到了这里，相信所有人都会被净化，只留下最初的和谐和宁静。
只是此刻却是残破得异常厉害，不仅大片的林木被摧毁，就连木质的城墙都有了许多焦黑的印记，像是被大火焚烧过一般。
此刻张荼从手链空间中找出了三个斗笠，其实本来想找几个遮阳帽，但是此刻发现，似乎斗笠更符合他们的气质，想到这里，不得不感叹一下边关月的贴心。
所以张荼友好地发过去一条消息：“夏清侯是谁？”
原本正在建邺城中布局规划的边关月，看到张荼这没头没脑的一句话，整个人直接麻木，脑壳之上更是蹦出了无尽的问号，第一次感觉一切超出了自己把握。
“怎么了？”张荼的嘴角露出一丝笑意，还有什么比逗弄这个腹有天下的边关月来的有趣，其实看到他一切尽在掌控之中的模样，张荼心中是真的颇为不爽。
因为边关月太过于完美，一切都在自己的计划之中，所以张荼不喜欢这种的完美，总想破坏一下，因为只有边关月在出现情绪波动的时候，那个超凡脱俗的边关月，才不像是边关的月光那般清冷，更像是一个有血有肉的人。
“你失踪的这一天，你去哪里了？为什么会出现的紊乱时间波动？”边关月沉默了许久之后，默默编辑出了一串文字，同时，他的行为也默认了一些东西，那边是张荼的举动，他一直都在关注着，或者说张荼的每一步，在背后都有边关月的默默注视。
看到边关月的回复，张荼微微停顿了一下，但仍旧是若无其事地回复到：“我去了你曾经去过的地方，所以知道了夏清侯和陆望舒。有没有想起来什么？”
边关月回到大殿深处，将自己藏在阴影之中，缓缓回复道：“我不是监视你，而是我怕你死得不明不白，报仇都没法报仇。”
这种解释无疑是没有任何说服力，可是张荼却是没有丝毫的介意的意思，至少他是如此表现的。对于张荼来说，自己的造化，甚至于生命都是来自边关月。他心中清楚得很，作为一个优秀的旱鸭子，掉入了汹涌澎湃的夷水之中，生还的希望可谓是小得可怜，若非是边关月，自己早已经加入了地狱中那汹涌的魂潮之中。
所以，对于边关月，张荼内心是感激的，所以他不在意边关月在自己的背后搞小动作，或者对自己有些监视，只要不伤害自己的挚爱亲朋，自己对于边关月的底线是低到近乎没有下限。
而且边关月并没有让自己失望，尽可能地为自己筹谋诸多，甚至闲暇时间，自己都忍不住思忖，边关月到底图的是什么。
“这个不重要，你就不好奇我是怎么知道的么？”张荼快速地回复道。
content_en:
Lu Wangshu, who sent them here, left quickly. "Is this the human world?" Zi Jin shouted excitedly, but then he seemed to remember something and said melancholy: "Zhang Tu, do you think there is really fate in this world?"
"Why do you say that?" Zhang Tu looked at the world. It looked like the human world, but not exactly like it. It was difficult for him to tell the difference for a while, but Lu Wangshu should not deceive them.
"It's nothing." Zijin's voice was a little low, because in her heart, ever since she came here, she always had a feeling that she would eventually return here.
The next second, Zhang Tu found that his comprehensive communicator had full signal for an instant, and then he was sure that they had indeed returned to the human world. He glanced at the automatic correction of the time and found that only one day and one night had passed since they disappeared.
The three of them all took out their mobile phones to confirm and update again, and went to various platforms to peek silently. At this time, they finally believed that the long years on the mountains had only lasted one day and night in the human world. Zhang Tu looked back silently and saw an endless open plain, with no sign of the Bansi Mountain Range.
To become stronger, you must become stronger!
After seeing the strangeness of the Sea of ​​Reincarnation, the tragic plight of the Jiaomu Jiao and the swordsman in black, the choice of the Beggar Sword Master, and the persistence of Lu Wangshu, he could not calm down. He had a serious sense of crisis, and at the same time there was an understanding deep in his heart that perhaps his opponent had never been in this world.
The process of them entering the Sea of ​​Reincarnation may have been intentional, but deep down in Zhang Tu's heart, he actually did not resent it. He was happy in his heart to be recognized and given important responsibilities. For the sake of this world and his own race, someone must stand up. His only worry was whether he could withstand it.
The three of them did not stay where they were, but moved forward quickly, trying to find the nearby ancient city of Incense and confirm the specific information. There are other colorful colors in the world now. The whole world is shrouded in a hazy clear light, and the warm and fragrant breath blows towards their faces, which makes the three of them feel like they are in another world.
Walking out of the desolation in front of them, Zhang Tu and others walked forward and came to an oasis. The dense jungle reminded them of the strange oasis on the holy mountain. But the jungle that emerged from ancient times before them was full of vitality, which made Zhang Tu and others feel relaxed and happy.
But the fly in the ointment was when the three people took off. However, I discovered that the pure land in front of me was filled with blooming flowers, fresh grass, and swaying green trees. There were several scar-like areas in the dots of sunlight, which destroyed the original harmony and tranquility.
Obviously the flames of war have burned this paradise.
If there were no monsters, the forest city in front of us would look like a city without the hustle and bustle of the world, without the intrigues of the world. When we get here, I believe everyone will be purified, leaving only the original harmony and tranquility.
But at this moment, it was extremely dilapidated. Not only were large tracts of trees destroyed, but even the wooden city walls had many charred marks, as if they had been burned by fire.
At this moment, Zhang Tu found three hats from the bracelet space. In fact, he originally wanted to find a few sun hats, but now he found that the hats seemed to be more in line with their temperament. Thinking of this, he had to sigh at Bian Guanyue's thoughtfulness.
So Zhang Tu sent a friendly message: "Who is Xia Qinghou?"
Bian Guanyue, who was originally planning the layout of Jianye City, saw Zhang Tu's meaningless words. His whole body went numb. Endless question marks popped up on his head. For the first time, he felt that everything was beyond his control.
"???"
"What's wrong?" A smile appeared on Zhang Tu's lips. What could be more fun than teasing Bian Guanyue, who has the world under his belt. In fact, Zhang Tu was really unhappy when he saw that he had everything under control.
Because Bian Guanyue is too perfect and everything is according to his own plan, Zhang Tu doesn't like this kind of perfection and always wants to destroy it, because only when Bian Guanyue has emotional fluctuations, the otherworldly Bian Guanyue is not as cold as the moonlight in Bian Guan, but more like a flesh and blood person.
"Where did you go on the day you disappeared? Why did the chaotic time fluctuations occur?" After being silent for a long time, Bian Guanyue silently edited a string of text. At the same time, his behavior also acquiesced to something. There was Zhang Tu's actions, and he had been paying attention to them. In other words, every step of Zhang Tu was watched silently by Bian Guanyue behind him.
Seeing Bian Guanyue's reply, Zhang Tu paused slightly, but still replied nonchalantly: "I went to the place where you have been before, so I know about Xia Qinghou and Lu Wangshu. Did you remember anything?"
Bian Guanyue returned to the depths of the hall, hid herself in the shadows, and slowly replied: "I am not spying on you, but I am afraid that you will die in an unknown way, and you will not be able to take revenge."
This explanation is undoubtedly unconvincing, but Zhang Tu doesn't mind at all, at least that's how he behaves. For Zhang Tu, his creation and even his life came from Bian Guan Yue. He knew very well that as an excellent landlubber, if he fell into the surging Yi River, his hope of survival was extremely small. If it weren't for Bian Guanyue, he would have already joined the surging soul tide in hell.
Therefore, Zhang Tu is grateful to Bian Guanyue in his heart, so he doesn't care if Bian Guanyue does little things behind his back or monitors him. As long as he does not hurt his beloved relatives and friends, his bottom line for Bian Guanyue is so low that it is almost unlimited.
